description:
Attach a receipt to an expense-claim line: a new file (``file_base64``, the
raw bytes, base64) OR an existing document's ``item_id``, exactly one; repeat
that ``item_id`` as ``receipt_from_upload`` when ``ingest_expense_receipt``
returned it. ``override_duplicate`` only after a duplicate refusal you checked.
name: attach_claim_receipt
